Priya: FYI noticed a regression on Llama3 13B perf in nightly run — 18% higher p99 latency for chat workloads since yesterday
Connor: ugh. any obvious commit?
Priya: looks correlated with the auto-kernel-selector change that prefers the fused-attn kernel for seq_len > 512. repro harness attached to the job: `bench/chat_throughput --model llama3-13b --seq 1024 --concurrency 8`
Eli: can we see KV-cache miss/eviction stats? might be interacting with fused kernel's KV layout
Priya: perf-bot posted logs from the job:
```
[2026-03-17T08:14:02Z] model=llama3-13b kernel=attn_fused seq=1024 batch=1 step=120 tokens/s=3200 p99=54ms
[2026-03-17T08:14:02Z] model=llama3-13b kernel=attn_split seq=1024 batch=1 step=120 tokens/s=3900 p99=46ms
KV-cache hits=0.87 evict_rate=0.12 avg_kv_alloc_us=102
```
Rina: that's interesting — fused kernel wins for throughput usually but has worse tail latency here. maybe batching heuristic changes made more variable batching windows
Connor: what changed in batching heuristics? last PR said "adaptive_window=enabled" to prioritize token latency under 200ms
Priya: right. adaptive_window now groups very short requests to fill GPU lanes which increases variance when seq_len distribution is bimodal (chat system prompts + long context)
Eli: hypothesis: fused kernel assumes contiguous KV layout; when we interleave cached KV updates with small-batch fused executions we hit extra memcpy + kernel-launch stalls
Priya: repro: run two clients, one long sequence (1024) and many short (64). baseline (old selector + simple batching) p99=44ms. new selector + adaptive_window p99=54ms
Connor: can you paste perf trace (simple sample)?
Priya: perf-bot uploaded a short trace excerpt and flame snippet:
```
# simplified trace events
0.000 ms request recv
1.4 ms route+enqueue
2.1 ms build_kv (memcpy 512KB)
6.8 ms kernel_launch(attn_fused)
60.1 ms kernel_exec
60.2 ms kv_commit
```
Eli: the memcpy and kernel_launch gap looks high. Are we switching CUDA streams when falling back to attn_split for some micro-batches?
Rina: log snippet shows stream=3 for fused, stream=1 for split. we set stream affinity per kernel in selector.
Connor: stream switching + small memcpy -> pipeline bubble => tail latency hit
Priya: quick mitigation options:
- revert adaptive_window (easy, immediate)
- force attn_split for seq<=512 and fused for >512 (selector tweak)
- change KV layout to allocate aligned GPU buffers to reduce memcpy time (more invasive)
Eli: I can prototype a selector rule: prefer split if concurrent short+long mix detected (cheap detect: variance(seq_len) > threshold)
Rina: also check RMSNorm/SiLU kernel variants — we recently added vectorized SiLU which may change pre-attn timing. if SiLU moved compute earlier it could desync our pipeline
Priya: good catch. we saw SiLU kernel upgrade merged yesterday by @Eli — maybe reorder across layers changed
Connor: action items
- Eli: add quick selector rule prototype + perf test (eta: 4h)
- Priya: run nightly bench with mixed workload reproducible harness and collect traces (I'm on it)
- Rina: audit stream assignments and memcpy sizes, see if we can avoid stream switch for combined kernels (eta: EOD)
- Connor: if prototype fails, plan to revert adaptive_window flag for tomorrow's canary (I'll prepare rollback)
Eli: starting selector patch now. local microbench shows memcpy drop from 102us -> 32us when using 256B alignment for KV buffers (weird)
Priya: noted. also will check rope_theta scaling defaults — Llama3 experiments changed default rope_theta to 10000 in model onboarding which can change compute pattern with long seqs
Rina: rope scaling affects rotary precompute size; that touches memory bandwidth. if rope_theta increased, we allocate larger sincos buffers per head which could bump memcpy time
Connor: excellent thread. keep logs compressed and upload to s3/perf/1768203456 for triage. add the 'perf' tag to the PRs
Priya: uploaded harness + traces: s3://redwood-perf/triage/1768203456/
Eli: quick note — quantized kernels for 8-bit may also pick different kernels; ensure quantization profile wasn't toggled in the nightly (I saw a config flip earlier)
Priya: confirmed quant_profile=default (no change).
Rina: if selector rule fixes it, we should also add unit test that simulates mixed seq lengths to avoid regression
Connor: agreed. also add a perf-test that runs p99 check for typical chat template (system + user messages)
Priya: thanks all. I'll update channel when I have the mixed-run results. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: Job 1768203456 finished. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/triage/1768203456/trace.json, bench.log
Eli: quick follow-up: selector tweak PR opened -> #5124. Marking as draft until perf results
Priya: ping when PR ready for canary.
Connor: moving to action items board.
Priya: closing loop for now — expect next update in ~6 hours.
